integrity: Count formulas proved by graph-wise normal form and elementary linear algebra; small-graph enumeration independently checks examples. Classical balanced-sign criterion attributed to existing XOR-game literature.
scientific_limitations: Binary outcomes, finite simple compatibility graph, pairwise contexts, marginal-consistent distributions with entries in {0,1/2,1}; no quantum-realizability implication; historical priority and independent audit unestablished.
title: Two-sample binary contextuality on graphs: a complete census and a sharp fraction threshold
